content:
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: metering.ingest.delay detected for customer-facing billing pipeline — severity: P2. Trigger: sudden backlog + token-count divergence. Pager delivered to #incidents and billing-oncall.

natalie (eng-sre): seeing error spikes on metering-consumer-2. Kafka lag ~120k. Token counts behind realtime by ~10-15% vs expected. customers flagged for overage alerts.

rob (billing): we already have several automatic overage flags firing. Can we pause the overage notification job until we reconcile?

jyoti (platform): temporarily silencing the overage webhook is risky but doable. We can gate notifications for 30m while team investigates. @marta can you confirm legal/CS okay with temporary suppression?

marta (billing-oncall): confirm we can pause notifications for 30m for noisy alerts, but we need to proactively message top impacted tenants. I'll draft a short note for enterprise customers.

lee (oncall): handoff — i'm oncall for eng-sre. taking lead. initial plan: (1) drain metering-consumer-2, (2) restart consumer with increased commit frequency, (3) replay backlog with controlled rate.

ash (product-ops): cc @support — please prepare an incident banner for status.redwood.ai indicating: "Some customers may see delayed usage reporting. Billing correctness is being investigated." No mention of overbilling.

natalie (eng-sre): quick telemetry dump from the aggregator:```sql
SELECT consumer_group, lag, messages_in_flight, avg_processing_ms
FROM metering.consumer_metrics
WHERE consumer_group LIKE 'metering-consumer-%'
ORDER BY lag DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- results (last 5m):
-- metering-consumer-2 | 120546 | 512 | 340ms
-- metering-consumer-4 | 12 | 48 | 120ms
-- metering-consumer-1 | 8 | 10 | 95ms
```

rob (billing): thanks. Can you query token delta by customer for the last 2 hours vs reported? we need a list of customers with >5% discrepancy so we can prioritize outreach and potential credits.

natalie (eng-sre): running quick mapreduce on reconciler:```bash
# rough command
python reconcile_tokens.py --start -2h --end now --out /tmp/delta_by_tenant.json
cat /tmp/delta_by_tenant.json | jq '. | map(select(.delta_pct>5)) | .[] | {tenant, delta_pct}' | head
```
Partial results: ACME Corp: 12.4%, beta-inc: 7.1%, free-school: 6.3% (low $), internal-test: 15.8%

marta (billing-oncall): good list. i'll prepare refund/credit proposals: ACME -> credit invoice equal to 12% of last 24h usage. need approval from finance for >10% credits. tagging @rob.

rob (billing): finance approval noted. I'll loop in finance via email and post the reference ticket here. Ticket FIN-3221.

jyoti (platform): root cause hypothesis: consumer commit offsets were stalled after a GC spike on aggregator-3 at 02:42Z; commits resumed but order of messages caused duplicate/incomplete aggregation window dedup. We'll need a fix in the consumer that robustly checkpoints per-tenant instead of per-partition.

lee (oncall): immediate mitigation actions executed: restarted metering-consumer-2 with env var COMMIT_FREQ=5s, replaying backlog at throttle=2000 msg/s. monitoring lag.

natalie (eng-sre): after restart: lag decreased to 18k in 12m. token-count delta moving towards 0 for most tenants. running reconciliation job in background; ETA ~45m to finish full pass.

ash (product-ops): status banner updated. Support template drafted: "We are investigating delayed usage reporting which may temporarily affect invoiced usage visibility. We do not expect customers to be billed incorrectly; any detected discrepancies will be corrected." — sending to enterprise severity contacts now.

marta (billing-oncall): disabling automatic overage emails. switched to queued manual review for alerts >10% delta.

rob (billing): placing a guard in billing pipeline to ignore abrupt >5% jumps that resolve within a 1h reconciliation window. I'll roll a hotfix to staging then prod if tests pass.

natalie (eng-sre): reconciliation progress: 60% complete. ACME, beta-inc, internal-test all showing catch-up tokens inserted; estimated correction within 30m for ACME.

lee (oncall): monitoring dashboards: latency back to green, consumer lag trending down. No new errors after restart. Marking incident as Mitigated for paging; keeping thread open for follow-up and postmortem.

ash (product-ops): customer-facing update scheduled in 30m with follow-up note once reconciliations finish.

marta (billing-oncall): created billing ticket BILL-8842 to track credits and manual reconciles. Adding all impacted tenants and proposed credit amounts.

rob (billing): post-incident action items: (1) add per-tenant checkpointing to reconciler (owner: jyoti), (2) lower max commit latency threshold to 10s (owner: natalie), (3) add canary to overage notifier (owner: marta).

jyoti (platform): ack on action items. will open infra PR for per-tenant checkpointing and start a design doc.

natalie (eng-sre): final status update: reconciliation finished at 1919503600. Final delta: ACME 0.4% (credited 11.6%), beta-inc 0.2% (credited 6.9%). No customers billed incorrectly. Closing paging. Will follow up with a 72h postmortem.

lee (oncall): incident closed for immediate paging. Leaving retrospect action assignment in #eng-postmortems. Great cross-team work, thanks all. :tada:
